wormald.shelfmark: BL, Printed Books, Henry Davis Collection 59
wormald.wormald_origin: A Nowell transcript; its identification is another discovery of Carl Berkhout (p. 262 n. 381).
wormald.overview: A third surviving Nowell transcript of Old English law, a luxury presentation copy of Alfred's laws alone. With the Otho and 'Somner' transcripts it belongs to the preparatory work for Lambarde's edition, not to the copy sent to his printer, and shows Nowell supplying clause headings.
wormald.key_quote: 'a third which is a de luxe presentation of Alfred's laws only' (p. 262)
wormald.doubts: Not in the guide; unknown to Liebermann. Wormald gives no date or further description here.
verify_notes: p. 262 and n. 381 checked. shelfmark set to Wormald's exact form; otherwise no changes.
overview: reworded to remove five-word runs shared with Wormald.
